_comment: Generated by tools/lpc/build-pack.ts (layout: tools/lpc/layout.ts). Frame rows per anim: row = first direction row (up,left,down,right), +1 per direction. anchor = feet contact point inside a 64x64 frame.

idle.note: breathing idle; falls back to the standing walk frame when a worn layer has no idle sprites

walk.note: LPC walk frames 1-8 (frame 0 = standing is the idle fallback)

sit.note: not an animation: 3 poses (ground knees-up, ground cross-legged, on a chair)

emote.note: hands on hips, hands on hips, arms raised (cheer)

shoot.note: LPC shoot has 13 frames; subsampled to 8 (draw, aim, release)

hurt.note: LPC hurt only faces down; last frame = lying on the ground

sleep.note: head + shoulders only (rows above bodyType.sleepCropY), eyes closed; drawn over a bed blanket

eat.note: seated on a chair. down: arms lift food to the mouth (upper body from bodyType.eatUpper); other directions: chewing head bob

carry.note: walk with both arms held forward at chest height (renderer draws the carried item)

work.note: hammer / knead motion reused from LPC thrust (adults) or slash (children); see bodyType.workSrc

cradle.note: draw the cradle frame lift px above the baby position (mattress height of a cradle object)

held.note: frames are in the holder's 64px frame coordinates (carry pose arms at rows 38-45); draw at the holder sprite rect + holder carry bob

credits.note: drawn from scratch in LPC palette ramps

authors: LPC child head/hair: see heads_human_child and hair_* credits
credits.note: body/garments drawn by script; head.png, face_closed.png, hair/*.png are re-positioned copies of LPC child head/hair frames (idle 0)
